voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: South Africa, nineteen ninety-nine. Searchers announced they had found the Waratah, the liner lost ninety years before.
She had left Durban in nineteen-oh-nine with two hundred and eleven aboard. None was ever seen again.
Explorer Emlyn Brown's sonar had found a wreck off that coast whose outline seemed to match.
Two years later, a dive reached it. It was another ship: a wartime freighter, lost in nineteen forty-three.
In two thousand four, after more than twenty years, he said he had no idea where else to look. The Waratah has never been found.
